I am not sure what batch I am in.  When does this ship?

Thanks

Hi Todd,

Your Harlo B30 on order Shop···· is in batch 4, and it ships November 14. The Power K. is already set aside at our Tennessee warehouse and goes out in the same box.

The US B30 units have started arriving at that warehouse. You can follow that shipment's progress to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

We'll email you the tracking as soon as your miner leaves.

Sarah

**Notes:**
- **Date and batch:** The batch 4 / November 14 answer comes from your order, which shows November 14 for the B30. The delay notices we sent you by email and text on September 15 also put batch 4 in the week of November 14. One thing doesn't match: my product notes say all open B30 orders ship October 30, but that date has already passed, so I used the order's date.
- **Warehouse:** The warehouse has your order on hold because the B30 is out of stock there. The Power K. is set aside. This fits other team replies from November 7 saying US B30s are arriving and shipping.
- **Nothing flagged:** I didn't change anything or flag this to the team, since a status question only needs the date. Your separate pool payout thread is still open, and I left it alone here.

I don't see a batch 4 on the tracker.

Sent from my iPhone

Hi Todd,

You're right, and I'm sorry for the confusion. "Batch 4" was the name from our September update, and it isn't how the tracker is laid out. I shouldn't have pointed you to it that way.

Your order still shows your Harlo B30 shipping November 14. The Power K. goes in the same box.

I've asked the team to confirm which shipment on the tracker covers your order. They're back Monday at 10am ET, and their answer will come to this email.

Sarah

**Notes:**
- **What I got wrong:** In my last reply I said Todd was in batch 4 and sent him to the tracker as if it listed batches. The "batch 4" name only came from our September 15 notice. Also, those internal notes went to Todd as part of the email.
- **Couldn't check the page:** The shipment-status page wouldn't load for me, so I can't tell him which card his order falls under.
- **Flag raised (question):** It asks the team to tell Todd which tracker shipment covers Shop····. Nothing on the order was changed.
- **Date:** The flag tool's timestamp says November 14, but today's hours line says Saturday, and I treated it as November 7. If it really is November 14, the B30 still hasn't shipped on its ship date. Check the order before Monday.
